Shipping policy

We ship to addresses in the United States only.

Orders over $50 ship free with standard shipping. Orders under $50 ship for a flat rate of $5.95.

Orders are processed within 1–2 business days. Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days after dispatch. You will receive a tracking number by email once your order ships.

We do not ship to P.O. boxes.
